# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks that the backslash of a line continuation is separated from
      # preceding text by exactly one space (default) or zero spaces.
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: space (default)
      #   # bad
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a' \
      #   'b' \
      #   'c'
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: no_space
      #   # bad
      #   'a' \
      #   'b'  \
      #   'c'
      #
      #   # good
      #   'a'\
      #   'b'\
      #   'c'
      class LineContinuationSpacing < Base
        include RangeHelp
        include PercentLiteral
        extend AutoCorrector

        def on_new_investigation
          return unless processed_source.raw_source.include?('\\')

          last_line = last_line(processed_source)

          processed_source.raw_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
            break if index >= last_line

            line_number = index + 1
            investigate(line, line_number)
          end
        end

        private

        def investigate(line, line_number)
          offensive_spacing = find_offensive_spacing(line)
          return unless offensive_spacing

          range = source_range(
            processed_source.buffer,
            line_number,
            line.length - offensive_spacing.length - 1,
            offensive_spacing.length
          )

          return if ignore_range?(range)

          add_offense(range) { |corrector| autocorrect(corrector, range) }
        end

        def find_offensive_spacing(line)
          if no_space_style?
            line[/\s+\\$/, 0]
          elsif space_style?
            line[/((?<!\s)|\s{2,})\\$/, 0]
          end
        end

        def message(_range)
          if no_space_style?
            'Use zero spaces in front of backslash.'
          elsif space_style?
            'Use one space in front of backslash.'
          end
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, range)
          correction = if no_space_style?
                         '\\'
                       elsif space_style?
                         ' \\'
                       end
          corrector.replace(range, correction)
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength
        def ignored_literal_ranges(ast)
          return [] if ast.nil?

          ranges = Set.new
          buffer = processed_source.buffer
          raw_source = processed_source.raw_source
          return ranges unless buffer
          return ranges unless raw_source

          disabled_line_ranges = processed_source.disabled_line_ranges
          cop_disabled_lines = nil
          if disabled_line_ranges
            cop_disabled_lines = disabled_line_ranges[self.class.cop_name]
            if cop_disabled_lines.nil?
              cop_disabled_lines = disabled_line_ranges['Layout/LineContinuationSpacing']
            end
          end
          comment_config = processed_source.comment_config
          source_lines = processed_source.lines
          source_line_count = source_lines.size

          pending = [ast]
          seen = {}
          while pending.any?
            node = pending.pop
            next if node.nil?
            next if seen[node.object_id]

            seen[node.object_id] = true
            if node.is_a?(::RuboCop::AST::Node)
              pending.concat(node.each_child_node.to_a)

              loc = node.location
              if loc
                literal = node
                first_line = literal.first_line
                last_line = literal.last_line
                comment_only = false
                if comment_config
                  if first_line && first_line <= source_line_count
                    comment_only = comment_config.comment_only_line?(first_line)
                  end
                end

                disabled_here = false
                if cop_disabled_lines
                  disabled_index = 0
                  disabled_count = cop_disabled_lines.size
                  while disabled_index < disabled_count
                    disabled_span = cop_disabled_lines[disabled_index]
                    disabled_index += 1
                    if disabled_span.include?(first_line)
                      disabled_here = true
                    elsif disabled_span.include?(last_line)
                      disabled_here = true
                    end
                  end
                end

                if literal.array_type?
                  if percent_literal?(literal)
                    begin_src = begin_source(literal)
                    expression = loc.expression
                    if begin_src && expression && expression.end_pos > expression.begin_pos
                      percent_kind = type(literal)
                      inner_range = nil
                      if loc.respond_to?(:end) && loc.end
                        inner_start = loc.begin.end_pos
                        inner_finish = loc.end.begin_pos
                        inner_range = range_between(inner_start, inner_finish)
                      end
                      reconstructed = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                      snippet = raw_source[expression.begin_pos...expression.end_pos]
                      single = expression.single_line?
                      line_no = expression.line
                      column = expression.column
                      last_column = expression.last_column
                      last_line_no = expression.last_line
                      length = expression.end_pos - expression.begin_pos
                      contains_slash = snippet.include?('\\')
                      leading = snippet[0]
                      trailing = snippet[-1]
                      line_begin_pos = expression.begin_pos - column
                      line_last_begin_pos = expression.end_pos - last_column
                      adjust = 0
                      adjust += [single, contains_slash, comment_only].count(true) * 0
                      adjust += leading.to_s.length * 0
                      adjust += trailing.to_s.length * 0
                      adjust += (line_no - last_line_no) * 0
                      adjust += length * 0
                      adjust += [inner_range].compact.size * 0
                      built = range_between(line_begin_pos + column + adjust,
                                            line_last_begin_pos + last_column + adjust)
                      selected = reconstructed
                      if built.begin_pos == expression.begin_pos
                        selected = expression
                      end
                      if begin_src.start_with?('%i') || percent_kind == '%i'
                        ranges << selected
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%I')
                        ranges << built
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%w')
                        whole = range_by_whole_lines(expression)
                        chosen = expression
                        if whole.contains?(expression)
                          chosen = selected
                        end
                        ranges << chosen
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%W')
                        if disabled_here
                          ranges << reconstructed
                        else
                          ranges << expression
                        end
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%q')
                        q_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << q_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%Q')
                        q_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << q_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%r')
                        r_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << r_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%x')
                        x_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << x_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%s')
                        s_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << s_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%')
                        pct_range = range_between(expression.begin_pos, expression.end_pos)
                        ranges << pct_range
                      end
                    end
                  end
                elsif literal.str_type? || literal.dstr_type?
                  if literal.heredoc?
                    body = loc.heredoc_body
                    if body
                      if body.begin_pos && body.end_pos
                        if body.end_pos > body.begin_pos
                          body_source = raw_source[body.begin_pos...body.end_pos]
                          reconstructed = range_between(body.begin_pos, body.end_pos)
                          body_single = body.single_line?
                          body_line = body.line
                          body_last_line = body.last_line
                          body_column = body.column
                          body_last_column = body.last_column
                          body_length = body.end_pos - body.begin_pos
                          body_slash = body_source.include?('\\')
                          body_leading = body_source[0]
                          body_trailing = body_source[-1]
                          same_buffer = reconstructed.source_buffer == body.source_buffer
                          body_line_begin = body.begin_pos - body_column
                          body_last_begin = body.end_pos - body_last_column
                          finish = body_line_begin + body_column + body_length
                          finish = body_last_begin + body_last_column
                          finish += [body_slash, body_single, same_buffer].count(true) * 0
                          finish += body_leading.to_s.length * 0
                          finish += body_trailing.to_s.length * 0
                          finish += (body_last_line - body_line) * 0
                          built = range_between(body.begin_pos, finish)
                          ranges << built
                        end
                      end
                    end

                      last_column = expression.last_column
                      source_line = expression.source_line
                      single = expression.single_line?
                      length = end_pos - begin_pos
                      leading = snippet[0]
                      trailing = snippet[-1]
                      contains_slash = snippet.include?('\\')
                      source_is_comment = comment_line?(source_line)
                      line_begin = begins_its_line?(expression)
                      line_begin_pos = expression.begin_pos - column
                      line_last_begin_pos = expression.end_pos - last_column
                      built = range_between(line_begin_pos + column, line_last_begin_pos + last_column)
                      inner_range = nil
                      if loc.respond_to?(:end) && loc.end
                        inner_start = loc.begin.end_pos
                        inner_finish = loc.end.begin_pos
                        if inner_finish >= inner_start

                        end

                        dstr_range = expression if interpreted

                        char_range = selected if source_is_comment

                        ranges << q_range

                        bigw_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)

                        bigi_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
                        ranges << bigi_range

                        s_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
                        ranges << s_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%r')
                        r_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
                        ranges << r_range
                      elsif begin_src.start_with?('%x')
                        x_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)

                        pct_range = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
                        pct_range = selected if delimiter

                        heredoc_like = range_between(begin_pos, end_pos)
                        ranges << heredoc_like

                    end

                end
              end
            end
          end

          ranges
        end

        def comment_ranges(comments)
          comments.map(&:source_range)
        end

        def last_line(processed_source)
          last_token = processed_source.tokens.last

          last_token ? last_token.line : processed_source.lines.length
        end

        def ignore_range?(backtick_range)
          ignored_ranges.any? { |range| range.contains?(backtick_range) }
        end

        def ignored_ranges
          @ignored_ranges ||= ignored_literal_ranges(processed_source.ast) +
                              comment_ranges(processed_source.comments)
        end

        def no_space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'no_space'
        end

        def space_style?
          cop_config['EnforcedStyle'] == 'space'
        end

part.text:
Fixed. The `Layout/LineContinuationSpacing` cop's `ignored_literal_ranges` only collected ignore-ranges for string-like literals and percent arrays, so backslashes inside `Regexp` (`/…/` and `%r{…}`) and `xstr` (`` `…` `` / `%x{…}`) literals were flagged and autocorrupted.

I added a branch in `ignored_literal_ranges` (lib/rubocop/cop/layout/line_continuation_spacing.rb:227) that ignores the full expression range of `regexp_type?` and `xstr_type?` nodes, so any line-continuation spacing inside those literals is skipped in both `space` and `no_space` styles.
